name: com.foxriverpress/press
title: Fox River Press
description: Read-only tools over Fox River Press open data: credit deadlines, court records, EV charging.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: Every site Fox River Press publishes: what it is for, how its pages are made and checked, and what it holds.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: The open datasets behind the sites' tools, each with its version, row count, license and download links.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: One dataset in full: its rows, columns, sources, method, version history and how to cite it. Use list_datasets for the ids.

id.description: A dataset id from list_datasets, for example credit-deadlines

tools.name: credit_deadlines
tools.description: Federal deadlines in U.S. consumer credit (disputes, debt validation, freezes, fraud alerts, reporting periods), each with the statute or rule that sets it and the guide that explains it. Filter by a word or phrase.

query.description: A word or phrase to match, for example dispute, freeze, collector or bankruptcy. Omit for every deadline.

tools.name: court_payment_plan
tools.description: The arithmetic of paying a court fine or fee over time: give the amount owed and either a monthly payment or a number of months. Returns the number of payments, the last payment and the total. Courts set their own terms; this does not say what a court will accept.

setup_fee.description: A one-time fee some courts add to a plan, in dollars

monthly_payment.description: What can be paid each month, in dollars. Give this or months.

months.description: How many months to pay over. Give this or monthly_payment.

monthly_income.description: Optional: monthly income, to show the payment as a share of it

tools.name: court_records_search
tools.description: The official online court case search for a U.S. state or the District of Columbia: who runs it, what a member of the public can find there, and what it costs, each fact with the court page it was read from and the day it was read. Give a state's name or two-letter code, or omit it for every state. Federal cases are on PACER, not here.

state.description: A state's name or two-letter postal code, for example Illinois or IL. Omit for every state.

tools.name: charger_rebates
tools.description: Programs that help pay for a home EV charger in a U.S. state or the District of Columbia: the state's own programs and those of its largest electric utilities that have been checked so far, each with the program, who runs it, the amount, who qualifies, its status (open, waitlist or closed), its end date when stated, and where to apply, read from an official page on the day given. A state or utility with no program names the page that was checked; a utility that funds a statewide program names it. Tax credits are not included. Give a state's name or two-letter code, or omit it for every state.

state.description: A state's name or two-letter postal code, for example Maryland or MD. Omit for every state.

tools.name: home_charging_estimate
tools.description: What a home circuit delivers to an electric car and what it costs: charger amps on a breaker by the 80 percent rule, kilowatts, miles of range per hour, cost per mile, monthly cost and the gas price at which a gas car costs the same per mile. Every assumption has a stated default and can be replaced.

breaker_amps.description: The circuit's breaker, one of 15, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 100. The charger draws 80 percent of it. Default 40.

volts.description: 120 for a regular outlet, 240 for Level 2. Default 240.

cents_per_kwh.description: Electricity price. Default 18.2 (U.S. residential average, 2026 (EIA projection)).

kwh_per_100_miles.description: The car's efficiency. Default 30 (example; your car's figure is on its fueleconomy.gov label).

gas_car_mpg.description: The gas car to compare against. Default 28.

tools.name: compare_chargers
tools.description: Home Level 2 EV chargers side by side, every maker value read from the maker's own page on a stated day. Give a breaker size to see what each would draw on that circuit, and a connector to keep only chargers for that port. No prices.

breaker_amps.description: The circuit's breaker, for example 40, 50 or 60

tools.name: network_readership
tools.description: The last 30 days of self-identifying machine readership across the network: answers an AI assistant read a page for, pages read by AI crawlers and by search crawlers, and readers who arrived from an AI product, per site; and how often each tool on this connector was called. Counts only; nothing about any reader or caller is stored.
